"""Format-sniffing demo for the Universal Reader record 24: The Universal Reader Field Guide Index.
A small working reader: detects a file's format from its first bytes."""
import hashlib
SAMPLES = [
    (b"%PDF-1.7 sample", "PDF document"),
    (b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n sample", "PNG picture"),
    (b"PK\x03\x04 sample", "ZIP archive"),
    (b'{"title": "record", "n": 1}', "JSON data file"),
    (b"<html><head><title>t</title></head></html>", "HTML web page"),
    (b"plain words with no signature at all", "plain text"),
]
def sniff(data):
    if data.startswith(b"%PDF-"): return "PDF document"
    if data.startswith(b"\x89PNG"): return "PNG picture"
    if data.startswith(b"PK\x03\x04"): return "ZIP archive"
    if data.lstrip().startswith(b"{"): return "JSON data file"
    if data.lstrip().startswith(b"<html"): return "HTML web page"
    return "plain text"
print("Universal Reader format-sniffing demo — record 24: The Universal Reader Field Guide Index")
results = []
for data, want in SAMPLES:
    got = sniff(data)
    results.append(got)
    print("  %r -> %s (expected %s)" % (data[:18], got, want))
print("Samples read: %d" % len(SAMPLES))
h = hashlib.sha256(("|".join(results)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: all six samples identified — " + ("pass" if len(results) == 6 else "fail"))
print("Test: every detection matches its expected format — " + ("pass" if all(sniff(d) == w for d, w in SAMPLES) else "fail"))
print("Test: unknown bytes fall back to plain text — " + ("pass" if sniff(b"hello world") == "plain text" else "fail"))
print("Test: reading is deterministic — " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(("|".join(results)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))
